rv.q: Bill T. Jones has created a theatrical experience that's as much a spiritual celebration as it is a musical biography, honoring the rebellious spirit of the Nigerian musician and political activist.
As with much of Gibney's recent work, Finding Fela! is well-researched, snappily edited and largely inessential.
I know I should feel hard-wired to enjoy - no, to love - "Fela!"
The highlight of the evening is an exhilarating challenge sequence, with each member of the chorus delivering a stunning solo.
Part biography, part music lesson, part dance party, Fela! is a unique theatrical experience, and Fela himself is its beating heart and soul.
